source.title: Bangor Urban District (from 1928 Borough of Bangor), register of elections of councillors and aldermen, 1904-1958: "Register of Elections of Aldermen and Councillors" held on 21 May 1952 (PRONI LA/20/1/DA/1; Keep notes "LA/20/1/DA/1 Part 3" #6, "LA/20/1/DA/1 Part 3" #7 (Ballyholme, Castle, Clifton; "Continued overleaf"); "LA/20/1/DA/1 Part 3" #8, "LA/20/1/DA/1 Part 3" #9 (Dufferin, Princetown and returns) (photo numbers count from 0))
source.publisher: Public Record Office of Northern Ireland (Bangor Borough Council records)
source.check: candidates, votes, the result and the ward returns read from the photographed register, which the returning officer signed (owner's PRONI photographs, transcribed 10-11 Nov 2026); names as the register writes them; the register gives no party labels; candidates' addresses are not copied

note: Triennial election of the Borough of Bangor, 21 May 1952: an alderman and three councillors in each ward. Castle Ward was the only contest. Returned unopposed ("No Poll").
